name: DoorLoop
positioning: The recent challenger — the same feature checklist as the incumbents, with an interface people learn in an afternoon.
description: DoorLoop is a cloud property management platform covering rentals, associations and commercial portfolios: listings and screening, leases and e-signature, rent collection, maintenance, accounting with QuickBooks sync, and tenant and owner portals. It competes on usability and published pricing.
real_estate_use: Its typical buyer is a manager leaving spreadsheets, or one leaving an older system whose interface their staff never mastered. The practical argument is onboarding time: a small team can go live in days, and the accounting exports cleanly to QuickBooks, which the bookkeeper already uses.
features: Lease templates with e-signature and automated renewals
Online rent collection with automatic late fees
Maintenance requests, vendor assignment and tracking

use_cases.job: Replace spreadsheets with a full system without a long onboarding
Collect rent, track maintenance and report to owners from one place
